profile.ja: ふうま一門の対魔忍。木霊を操る木遁使い。木霊は無機物に取り憑いて自在に動かす、武器を強化する、索敵する、など、きぬの望みに応えて様々な働きをしてくれる。温和で優しい性格だが、怒らせると非常に怖い。その名は絹であり鬼怒でもある。出雲家はふうま一門の中でも名門であり、優秀な忍法使いを何人も輩出している。きぬもその一人である。後に、同じふうまの対魔忍である佐郷文庫と夫婦となり娘・鶴を産んだ。数年前に病により死去、現在は故人。
profile.en: She is a Taimanin of the Fuuma clan, a wood jutsu user who manipulates wood spirits. The wood spirits can possess inorganic objects, move freely, enhance weapons, and perform reconnaissance, all in response to her wishes. She has a gentle and kind personality, but can be very intimidating when angered. Her name, Kinu, means both silk and devil's wrath. The Izumo family is a renowned house within the Fuuma clan, having produced many excellent ninja. Kinu is one of them. She later married a fellow Fuuma Taimanin, Bunko, and gave birth to a daughter named Tsuru. She passed away a few years ago due to illness and is now deceased.

text.ja: 出雲きぬ。ご下命を拝し参上しました。いかようにもお使いくださいね
text.en: I'm Izumo Kinu. I've arrived to serve you, Captain. Please feel free to give me any orders.

text.ja: この子達ですか？　木霊、名の通り木に宿る霊で戦闘だけでなく索敵から部隊運用、日常生活まで助けてくれる頼もしい仲間ですよ
text.en: These children? Wood spirits, as the name suggests, are spirits that inhabit wood, and they're reliable companions who can help with not just combat, but also reconnaissance, troop deployment, and daily life.

text.ja: 訓練の良いところは、実戦と違い死力を尽くして全てを出し切っても死なないところです。では、死力を尽くす訓練を始めましょう
text.en: The good thing about training is that, unlike real battles, you can give it your all without dying. So, let's start our all-out training.

text.ja: 結婚も戦と同じです。心構えと覚悟。先人の残したものを背負い共に生きるのですから、であれば敬意と愛は生まれるものです
text.en: Marriage is just like war - it's all about mindset and determination. We're living together, carrying on the legacy of our predecessors, so it's only natural that respect and love will grow.

text.ja: 貧すれば鈍する……人の基本は衣食住にあります。家を守る者として、家事全般と基となる教養はもちろん、習得しておりますよ
text.en: Poverty dulls the mind... a person's basics are food, clothing, and shelter. As a guardian of the household, I've acquired not just general housework skills, but also the fundamental education that comes with it.

text.ja: おかえりなさいませ、主様
出雲はふうまの名門。他家に嫁ごうともその重責は変わりません。その重さの分だけ、文庫様の足元を支える礎となることでしょう
text.en: The Izumo family is a prestigious house within the Fuuma clan. Even if I were to marry into another family, the weight of responsibility wouldn't change. But I'll become the foundation that supports Bunko, and that's what gives my life meaning.

text.ja: 嫁いでからしかできない学べないこと、成せないことがありますので……文庫様にはもっと積極的になっていただきたいのですが……
text.en: There are things you can only learn, accomplish, or experience after getting married... I wish Bunko would be more proactive, though...

text.ja: あふっ、あむ、んっ、んちゅ、ぢゅるっ、ぢゅろぢゅっぢゅぞ、ぢゅ、はあ……あぁ、きぬにお世継ぎを仕込んでくださいっ！
text.en: Ah, ah, mm, nchu, jyuru, jyro jyuppyu, jyu... Ha, ah, please give me a child, Kinu.

text.ja: お゛おっ、お゛おんっ、おっおっお゛おイグぅっ、イグっ、っっ、お世継ぎ孕むぅう゛うううう～～～～っっ！！
text.en: O-oh, o-oh, o-oh, o-Igu, Igu, uuuuuuu! I'm going to have a child, I'm going to have an heir!

text.ja: はあっ、はあっ、んっっお゛、お゛っ、お゛ふ、ふーーっ、もぉ、いつも気を、失うまで、おほっ！　お求めに、なるんですから……
text.en: Ha, ha, mm, o-oh, o-oh, o-fu, fuuu... I always lose myself, get carried away, and end up like this... because that's what you want, Master.
